name: suspender rollout v. 2
description: A rollout using suspension handles, a second variation. It challenges the abs as you extend your body forward and pull back.
instructions: Kneel facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll your arms forward as your body leans out in a straight line.
Go only as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
